flags.label: Quantity
flags.warning: The order is for 1,200 pieces but the factory sheet plans 1,000. Production is 200 pieces short of what the buyer is paying for.
flags.reason: Quantity conflict changes the whole cutting plan.

flags.label: Ship date
flags.warning: Buyer documents say 15 Dec 2027, the factory sheet says 20 Dec 2027. That is five days late against the PO and will miss the booking.
flags.reason: Ship date drives penalties and freight booking.

flags.label: M · chest cm
flags.warning: Size M chest is 52 cm on both buyer documents but 50 cm on the factory sheet. Every M garment will be 2 cm too small.
flags.reason: Measurement conflict changes fit across 600 pieces.

flags.label: S · chest cm
flags.warning: Size S chest is 50 cm on the buyer documents and 48 cm on the factory sheet. The whole size run is being cut 2 cm narrower.
flags.reason: Same grading error as size M, so it affects the full run.

flags.label: L · chest cm
flags.warning: Size L chest is 54 cm on the buyer documents and 52 cm on the factory sheet. Confirm the grading before cutting starts.

flags.label: Colour
flags.warning: Buyer documents specify Navy, the factory sheet says Blue. Navy and Blue are different shades on a fabric card and the dye lot cannot be changed after cutting.
flags.reason: Colour naming difference with a real dye consequence.

flags.label: Composition
flags.warning: The factory sheet adds 5% elastane to a 100% cotton order. That changes shrinkage, hand feel and the fibre content printed on the care label.
flags.reason: Fibre change is significant but may be a mill substitution a merchandiser can resolve.

flags.label: Care label
flags.warning: The tech pack and purchase order both require a printed care label; the factory sheet lists it as not stocked and not ordered. Without it the shipment fails labelling compliance.
flags.reason: Missing care label blocks export and is a compliance gap.
